name: Lysloftet
description: Iben bor mellem to gamle træer i udkanten af parken. Fra vinduespladsen kan hun se byens lys, mens hun tegner nye lanterner til sit Blazor-værksted.

scenes.alt: Iben flyver hen mod Lysloftets store buede vindue. En cykel står ved trappen op til den ravgule dør.
scenes.prompt: 3:2 hand-sculpted stop-motion clay illustration with the approved Iben character reference, curly dark ponytail, two feelers, indigo wing covers, a glowing segmented abdomen and no glasses. One beautiful environmental establishing shot of Iben's home exterior at blue hour. Modern compact loft nestled between tree trunks at the edge of a Danish city park, curved cedar timber facade with a broad arched window, ochre-lit round doorway and little sheltered balcony. Handmade ceramic lantern with leaf cutouts hangs at the entrance, a bicycle at the foot of the stairs, rain-speckled leaves. Iben, in her signature purple casual overshirt and straight black jeans, small but recognisable, flies home down a curving amber light trail. Her portrait should not dominate: the building is the subject. Side perspective with clean contemporary shapes, subtle lived-in details; a house she could inhabit, no face in the facade and no generic fantasy hut. This is an architectural miniature exterior, no device screens and no words.

scenes.alt: Iben sidder i vindueskarmen med sin skitsebog og tegner lanterner. Ved siden af hende lyser en lille lerlanterne.
scenes.prompt: 3:2 hand-sculpted stop-motion clay illustration with the approved Iben character reference, curly dark ponytail, two feelers, indigo wing covers, a glowing segmented abdomen and no glasses. A quiet intimate wide architectural interior of Iben's modern treehouse loft at night: the same large arched window between two thick trunks as the visual anchor, curved warm wood ribs overhead, a small low mustard reading couch, music turntable and bookcase, a simple mug on a side table, one hand-cut ceramic lantern. Young Iben in her open purple overshirt, off-white tee and charcoal jeans curls up on the window seat drawing three alternate lantern shapes in a small open sketchbook; her indigo wing covers and amber glow gently illuminate the pages. Character in profile with her dark high ponytail visible. Wide candid photograph of a handcrafted set, contemplative not posing, contemporary lived-in space, soft reflected indigo night light outside. No text, no big classroom monitors.
